summary: Megan Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General Meeting and Proxy Statement for a meeting scheduled July 13, 2026. The meeting proposals include a share consolidation (reverse stock split) at a ratio up to 1-for-400, to be implemented at the board's discretion within two years, and amendments to the memorandum and articles to shorten notice periods. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is disclosed. This is a routine proxy solicitation for governance housekeeping items, not a special situation.
